item.title: Love at Long Last
item.description: Interdimensional communication allows husband and wife to say goodbye...and accidentally ruin the world.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): existential/Emotional

Page Layout (Optional):

  • Credentials Required
  • Object Description (yellow universe)
  • Object Description (red universe)
  • A series of messages between two Foundation personnel from parallel universes, (yellow universe)
  • A series of messages between two Foundation personnel from parallel universes (Red universe)
  • Event Log: Gothic Storm: First known RMK-Class Scenario for both parallel worlds (Yellow universe)
  • Event Log: Gothic Storm: First known RMK-Class Scenario for both parallel worlds (Red universe)

Elevator Pitch:

+ show block
– hide block


The object is a pair of particles in between two separate branching worlds that allow for the communication between these two timelines via the transmission of information (possibly through Morse Code). A researcher by the name of Dr. Underwood attempts to contact her recently-deceased husband's counterpart in the alternate timeline, in a world where she had died rather than him during a similar event (possibly a containment breach, as both had worked together at the foundation when alive). The article contains a record of these messages, as well as documentation of cataclysmic events that transpired as a result of Dr. Underwood's attempts to reconnect with her husband.

Central Narrative:

+ show block
– hide block

Dr. Underwood's husband had recently died two years prior due to a freak accident. Underwood isolates herself to focus on her work, and makes a breakthrough in inter-dimensional communication, where she comes into contact with Dr. Chase, her husband's counterpart in another dimension. In their communication, Chase reveals that Underwood had been the one to pass in his dimension, rather than him. As they talk, massive differences between the two worlds become evident, the primary one being that Chase's universe orbits a Red Dwarf while Underwood's earth (our Earth) orbits a Yellow dwarf. Eventually, the two realize that their communication is causing their realities to bleed into one another. Chase attempts to sever their connection to keep the two worlds separate, but Underwood continues to message him. This causes both particles to combine, accelerate the fusion process between both worlds. This leads to an event known as "Gothic Storm", the first known Reality-Merging Class Scenario (RMK-Class) in that reality. The aftermath is chaotic, and leads to public awareness of the Foundation, the release of numerous anomalies, and shifts of entire galaxies in the universe. Dr. Underwood had seemingly disappeared, while Dr. Chase was discovered in her office. The document ends with an interview with Chase, and remains the only documentation of this event

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The concept of an RMK-Class Scenario hasn't been used much on the wiki before. Additionally, it (attempts to) question the ethics of sacrificing the whole for personal gain. It attempts to paint the characters as both selfish and stingy, as well as human and sympathetic. I will admit that the concept itself isn't the most original, but the story and its consequences certainly are.

Additional Notes: This isn't my original story: I received the idea from this youtube video, and tried to make a unique ending: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K3W61Ae0M9g

item.title: The Unrune (For Greenlight)
item.description: A bizarre rune that makes no sense and a man that makes even less
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): Standard SCP layout followed by information on where the object was recovered from and the groups connected with it. Possible addendums or test logs will tie in more of the important story

Elevator Pitch: A rune stone that defies physics, disobeys logic, and removes any sense of comfort. According to all attempts to gather data, it doesn't exist, yet we perceive it with our senses. However the rune engraved on it can only be seen, not felt, and in any image of the object it is blank.

Central Narrative: A cult worshipping the god of chaos believes this rune stone imprisons him and it is their duty to set him free once more. The GOC ended up with it, tried to destroy it and couldn't, and decided to give it to the foundation since containing is more their speed. The rune isn't what the cult thinks, but there's more to it than the foundation knows and it ties into a larger story relating to this so called god and his cult.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The object defies reality and physics and is tied to some god, but isn't really dangerous or powerful. It's more focused on the story I want to introduce but a reality defying object that doesn't do much and a god that isn't a god might be refreshing amongst the massive distortions and apocalyptic deities.

Additional Notes: This IS NOT meant to be some new all powerful, world ending, eldritch being. I don't want to make this about yet another god who wants to destroy humanity. I'm starting small, with this rune, so I don't come across like it's my goal to top anybody else or "have the baddest scp". Just want some cool ideas and a good story because that's what I personally love.

item.title: Survey, Capture, Pursue
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Action

Page Layout (Optional): The Containment Procedure is crossed out.

Elevator Pitch: The SCP itself are two books that are quantum entangled in the future. These books update as they are being written in the future. One of these books is a log of scientists trying to experiment with quantum entangling and details every single book that was entangled to the future and where to get them. This book gets taken, and the SCP Foundation has to find out who stole it using evidence and the other book, which was entangled in time by someone in the future warning them that they have to stop the thief from taking the book because society in the future will fall apart under one man's power.

Central Narrative: The central narrative is from the SCP Foundation's perspective, tracking down an object that was taken from the inside and trying to find who did it before they escape. Basically a reverse heist that explores some of the Foundation's security protocols.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Lots of twists and turns, a more story driven SCP that deals with slowly uncovering how someone stole the SCP as the Foundation tries to catch them before they escape.

item.title: Worldwarden
item.description: An anomalous phenomenon appearing in the forest that temporarily compels those exposed to it to destroy intrusions on the wilderness
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Fantasy

Elevator Pitch:

  • Appears as a deer or other local horned mammal trapped in a tree, fence, etc.
  • Often partially consumed or decomposing but the head typically remains lifelike
  • Individuals who come across it develop aggression towards whatever development is threatening the area and causing the SCP to manifest. They gain mild supernatural strength and endurance, as well as enhanced senses and become distressed if they are kept from accomplishing damage to the development
  • Those exposed retain an increased sense of connection with wilderness, but no powers or anger
  • The deer becomes fully skeletonized and loses anomalous properties if the ecosystem is damaged beyond repair or if the "appointee" is successful in neutralizing the development. Plants will rapidly cover the site of the development

Central Narrative:
*The world is fighting back against human and anomalous incursion but offers the chance for redemption to those lucky enough to receive its blessing
*The foundation can use this phenomenon to its benefit, but only if they tread carefully
*At first it's a threat to be neutralized, but through addenda, we learn that the foundation can exploit this for MTF operatives in wilderness scenarios.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
Incident log about a disastrous breach caused during the development of a new site at the hands of one of their own who came into contact with this SCP

Additional Notes:

item.title: My first SCP; The Corn Monkeys
item.description: please give me feedback to help greenlight my SCP
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Page Layout (Optional): SCP Format

Elevator Pitch:
A Race of monkey like creatures that:
*live in a corn field in southern Wisconsin that shows anomalous properties
*have extremely long top teeth and claws
*can use teeth and claws to extract the spine from a live human in seconds
*uses the spine to craft a makeshift tail to be used to attract a mate
*can not leave the cornfield without dying within minutes
*has i diet consisting of only corn grown in that field and human blood
*will die violently if fed anything else
*help to exponentially increase the yield of the crop grown in the field
*can mimic the crying and screams of a victims children to lure in to the field to be killed

Central Narrative:
Scp-xxxx are hairless monkey "like" creatures with large bulbous eyes and have elongated limbs. The creatures teeth and claws are also dis-proportionally elongated, with only the top portion of teeth being elongated in this way. Their spines are curved and distort wildly and they hunch over when on all four limbs. However, the spine can violently and grotesquely be straightened when threatened and standing in the up right position. Due to this violent transformation the spine is always exposed, being ripped through the skin during transformation.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
Scp-xxxx also posses the ability to mimic the sound of a lost child, crying and screaming for help. This has a psychological effect on most victims with children of their own as the cry's can mimic the victims offspring. It furthermore has a some what hypnotic effect on the victim, filling them with a misplaced sense of bravery and willingness to do what ever it takes to save the "lost child".

Additional Notes: I am looking for critiques and feedback on my writing. i am also seeking greenlight and any help building off this concept

item.title: Mothers Know Best
item.description: How proud is your Mom of you, really?
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: No

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Page Layout (Optional): Short description with a series of logs that relate multiple unconnected cases

Elevator Pitch: Parasitic worms that have the appearance of elongated human fetuses. They emerge from the wombs of mothers undetected and attach themselves to the mother's (adult) offspring like a leech. Using memetic camouflage to avoid detection, they begin mutating the host's biology and psychology in order to transform them into forms that would please the mother most. They then feed off of the resultant affection given to the host by the mother.

Narrative etc here
wow there it is

Central Narrative: There are three cases logged. In one, a conservative mother estranged from her trans daughter is delighted when the parasite begins to cause the daughter to "de-transition." When the Foundation contains the subject and removes the parasite, the daughter returns to normal. (disclaimer: it is not lost on me that this is a sensitive topic. As a trans individual myself, it is my intention to play on the horror of a transphobic mother/daughter relationship, and not to merely act out conversion therapy.)

In the second, shortest log, a child in a healthy relationship with the mother is infected, but the parasite shrivels and dies, unable to increase its intake of affection because the mother is happy with her child as they are.

In the third, a parasite manifests in an extremely (but subtly) abusive relationship in which the mother exhibits masked hostility towards her child. The parasite, unable to find a form that would please the mother, mutates the host in bizarre ways before bringing them to the brink of death, implying that the only scenario that would please this mother is the near-death of her child. The Foundation recovers the parasite, resuscitates the victim, and re-homes them away from their mother.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A parasite that horrifies readers not only with biological manipulation, but also by visibly manifesting the toxic consequences of abusive expectations for adult children. Imagine if you were forced against your will to please your mother. Not a scenario I'd relish, as much as I love my mom.

Additional Notes: I think this piece will live or die on the effectiveness of the case logs. How can I best insure that these land? Are they the best way to explore this particular topic?

item.title: Awaiting Greenlight / The Book of the Siners
item.description: A corrupt mind corrupt its kind
item.content:encoded:
Seeking greenlight: Yes

Page type: SCP Article

Elevator pitch: A Book made by God (I presume) or Peter Binsfeld to test humans of their sins. If an individual fails the test they will be tortured by the biblical being assigned to that certain sin and have their face and name burned into the pages of the book forever trapped in eternity.

Central narrative: It first sets the focus on the possible origin of the book and then the trial runs itself. If an individual opens the book and begins to read it they fall into a trance and are unable to move. Note that the individual must have to book in its hands or else no words will appear for the person. It is to note that only for the person holding the book the text appears. At next, the trial runs for each of the sins begin which I need to figure out as well to make it accurate according to the sin itself. This will also go in order and after each passed test it gets harder and harder (by that I mean that the order in which the sins will be tested goes from "weakest" sin to "strongest" in terms of passing). Ultimately if an individual fails to pass a test the icon of the according sin will appear and torture the human. Their name and face will be burned into the last pages of the book (which can be read by anyone without any fear of getting trapped) and along the sin which they failed to overcome including their torture. Their soul is therefore trapped inside the book unable to escape leaving the body to show signs of their horrible torture.

Hook, attention grabber: I think it is very interesting to maybe learn about the different trial runs of certain humans with their backstory and also give a hint or two about the price of passing all the tests by the sins. But ultimately there will be no human to this date who has passed the test…or maybe their will but that I would still need to plan and think about.

item.title: Emergency broadcast system from space. Looking for greenlights
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror, Sci-fi

Page Layout (Optional): normal

Elevator Pitch: The foundation periodically intercepts an audio signal from space, specifically somewhere in the Andromeda constellation, that can be understood by everyone, no matter what language the person speaks. the foundation is unable to recreate the message. The message warns, that there has been an unknown accident in a place outside the milky way. Its suggested, that some sort of anomalous system has failed and potentially released an anomalous entity

Central Narrative: The signal was first intercepted in 2012, by a small team of scientists. One of them was from the foundation. He alerted the foundation and it overtook the research of the signal and the rest of the scientits, that originally found it were amnesticized. The signal periodically gets intercepted biyearly. That makes 4 signals, each would be documented in the article, showing the progression of the event. First one - Announcment of the start of the event. Second - Progression of the event. Third - Dangerous development of the event. Fourth - Progress report on the event. In the end, the foundation waits for the next signal in 2022.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I think the hook would be the idea of an emergency broadcast intercepted from an alien race, that has a Foundation, similar to the SCP Foundation and of course also the mystery of the event and following along how it develops.

Additional Notes: This would be my first article.

item.title: The chocolate man. Seeking a greenlight and feedback
item.description: Seeking greenlight and feedback for an idea I have had in my head since I joined.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking greenlight: Yes

Page type: SCP Article

Genre: Emotional with a pinch of mystery.

Elevator pitch: Without the backstory, it is just a chocolate statue that can only move if a room is at or above the melting point of chocolate and any human it touches is transformed into a blob of chocolate that can sprout hundreds of little leg-like appendages to move around at any temperature above -10 degrees celsius.

Central narrative: It follows a baker who has suffered the loss of some of his loved ones. To cope, he recreated his deceased brother out of chocolate. Then a group of cultists approach him and offer to bring it to life, for a price. He graciously accepts the offer and the cultists perform a ritual to bring the statue to life. The baker asks what the price is and the cultits tell him he will see. The price was that anyone the statue came into contact with would turn into chocolate. The Foundation contained it and brought the baker in for an interview. During the interview, as he starts to explain how the cultists brought it to life, he enters a state of paranoia and gets out of the interview room, he is later found and terminated.

Hook, attention grabber: I think the story that is expressed through the baker will make the reader feel a sense of empathy for him, considering he has lost many loved ones. And I think that the few parts that are redacted will leave the reader wanting more.

item.title: An scp plot, looking for feedback and greenlight
item.description: An humanoid scp breachs contaiment and was killed, but this was the plan the whole time
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional):Drama/Mistery

Elevator pitch: A revenge plot, guy gets contained, escaped and is subsecuently killed, twist is he might not be anomalous at all and the people who capture him wants revenge on a very real very non-anomalous crime.

Central Narrative:
Opening by stating that this scp is both consider neutralized and is under scrutiny to decide wether he was or not anomalous. It describes an anomalous human with the ability to control people's mind if some specific requirements are met. Captured by an agent close to one of his victims(who was assaulted and killed by the SCP).The lead Researcher, a psychiatrist, allegedly gets controlled and helps the SCP escape, who ends up running into an ambush of the Goc, who kill him on sight

+ Ok, whats the twist?
- I see

The reality would be very much non-anomalous, the SCP has no such mind control abilities, just a charismatic personality and some antisocial disorders that makes him use his charisma to lure and assault woman at bars, his last victim is a family member of both the agent and the psichiatrist, who, with some help of other staff members, plot to classify him as an SCP, use the cold mindset of the foundation to run "quite unnecessarily painful" experiments on him, then pretend to be on his side and help him "escape" to his death. After the failed escape attempt, the research team members would defect/be demoted/ be terminated and the idea of they being controlled would still hang in the air, being that the reason the scp file was not deleted as a non-anomalous thing

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Quite like the Murder on the Orient Express, a story where a lot of people plot to murder someone who killed a family member, with an SCP twist that shows that the foundation could very well be containing normal people if you make enough people believe someone has special powers.

Additional Notes: i was planing of have some addenda of email exchanges among the reseach team, that starts to show more and more nonsensical text in the lines of "ljxk kh sp tpcbhnt lgml" that looks like tipical cognitohazzardous stuff but in reality is a cipher meant to help the plotters communicate while still feeding the mind control theory.

item.title: Wikidot is Loading Again
item.content:encoded:
I swear to god I got three wikidot crashes just trying to post this.

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: Joke SCP

Genre:Comedy

Elevator Pitch: Multiple wikidot users start dying, seemingly of old age, while in front of their computers. Why? Because wikidot kept crashing and loading, and they were waiting for it to work properly, of course.

Central Narrative:
In addition to what was described above, the narrative would then shift to two very annoyed Foundation researchers who are trying to upload this SCP documentation to the servers… only for them to keep crashing and loading. Literally taking years off their life everytime. I think that's an expression in english, at least. They both have stuff to do after so they gotta finish this tonight, but the damn site just keeps crashing…!

Hook/Attention-Grabber: To be honest this is just a way to jokingly express my frustration at the recent wikidot slowness and crashes. I figure it would have good comedic potential, especially since we all had to deal with this situation- making it pretty relatable too.

item.title: Eye see you
item.description: Eyes that appear where no one looks
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights:Yes

Page Type:SCP Article

Elevator Pitch:SCP-XXXX is an organism composed exclusively of an ocular organ. This entity manifests on any kind of surface where no individual is looking currently. Revealing their eyelids, which have a similar texture to the surface where they manifest.

These anomalies are of various sizes, usually appearing in large swarms in a same surface, they can't overlap each other, and they have at least 5 cm of difference between them. In the case that sighting or the surface is affected in any way, the entities will disappear instantly, leaving no trace and having no sound.

These entities are in a literal sense, invisible to society and most likely everywhere on this world. It is currently fully impossible for any type of humanoid creature to see them, therefore it is impossible to demonstrate their existence.

Central Narrative:This SCP hasn't been spotted nor discovered, instead, it is only mentioned or known by other SCP with higher intelligence or knowledge than humans, due to the amount of mentions from many SCPs without any correlation with one another, it has been decided to classify this entity as an SCP, despite not having any proof of its existence.

SCP-XXXX hasn't been accepted by most employees in the foundation however, it is a controversy and some consider it real and accept its classification, while others don't and believe it should be removed.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:By not being fully confirmed of its existence and only by trust of many other SCPs, it is a truly unknown SCP, if it even exists.

Additional Notes:A similar concept may exist already and I'm unaware of it, it may seem a bit obvious but this is based on religions and how it's based around our beliefs.

item.title: Around the world
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pit:
• SCP-xxxx is a working compass, observation outside the area of 200m radius from SCP-xxxx on the area within will result as if there is currently no SCP-xxxx and sapient being (having intelligence at least equal to lizards) inside the area. Observers from inside will perceive thick white fog at the border of the area which can't be seen through.
• SCP-xxxx-1 is any sapient being that currently observing SCP-xxxx, other SCP-xxxx-1 or on SCP-xxxx-2

+ show block
– hide block

• If there are about 11 to 35 SCP-xxxx-1 at the moment, SCP-xxxx might transfer all SCP-xxxx-1 along with everything thing in their sight and touch to the magnetic South Pole a planet designated as SCP-xxxx-2 in an unknown dimension, when in SCP-xxxx-2, SCP-xxxx lose its previous anomolous property, instead when SCP-xxxx is destroyed or has a distance more than 10m away from all SCP-xxxx-1 and out of sight, SCP-xxxx will reappears within 10m of the closest SCP-xxxx-1.
• SCP-xxxx-2 has a diameter estimated about 1100km despite having gravitational force same as earth. SCP-xxxx-2 surface is made up of places in and out side our dimension, those places are constantly changing when out of observation. Interaction on SCP-xxxx-2 affect those places where they come from (a record of expedition in SCP-xxxx-2 was found in an abandoned house). The only way known to get out of SCP-xxxx-2 is to put SCP-xxxx directly on the magnetic North Pole of the planet, that will result in all alive sapient being get back to an unobserved area in our dimension near where they started. Length of days on SCP-xxxx-2 is inconsistent. Stars other than the sun change after each day.

Central Narrative: The foundation found SCP-xxxx after many report of missing in a small town, MTF team was sent in for investigation.
• Expedition 1 summary:
Upon recovering SCP-xxxx, it manifested and transferred 11 researchers and the MTF team to SCP-xxxx-2. After more than 2 years, they became the first people to exit SCP-xxxx-2. At this point, SCP-xxxx property weren’t fully understood and classified as keter
After that SCP-xxxx activated several times and caused lost of many personnel but SCP-xxxx didn’t activate while they tried to test it
• Expedition 2 summary:
6 guards, several class d and researchers were transferred, they got out with loss of most people. This expedition gave the foundation a lot of valuable information about SCP-xxxx.

Many was carried out on animals, the foundation has some sense of SCP-xxxx and finally came up with an effective containment procedure. SCP-xxxx reclassified as euclid.

I planned to have 4 expedition but I haven’t come up with ideas for 3rd and 4th one, I planned the 3rd to be the record left over from previous activation of SCP-xxxx

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I find this idea have many potential. I think that it would be interesting to see how people deal with anomolies while in other dimension, they might be some unknown anomolies or known SCP.

item.title: SCP IDEA: An Alive Fort
item.description: An alive fort that dispenses a chemical to lure people inside the fort to try to kill them with traps and more.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes ( I would like criticism at this stage as well )

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch : A giant fort that turns out to be alive and tries to lure animals inside the fort. The more people it eats, it will evolve every 18 humans. It will lure people in by making them feel attracted and makes want to go in. Then, inside the fort, they will die from traps. It seems to be alive but it has no organs. There is also a human civilization that is deep. Any attempt to destroy it so far has been rendered useless. It has existed for a long time.

Central Narrative : It will follow a squad of MTF teams with a body camera. going in and trying to find out what is happening. Then, one by one, they all get murdered by the traps. The deeper they go in, the more sinister it became. They then found out there was a human population in their. They ate the scraps of the humans to survive. They turned out to be hostile and was quickly shot down. As they went deeper in the fort, it eventually has a dead end. The MTF team goes back up but then there would be a yell for help. Then the log ends.

Hook/Attention Grabber : This idea is unique because I have never seen a fort that actually alive. It would be a good SCP in my opinion.

item.title: SCP-5212 "The Carismatic Skull" looking for greenlight
item.description: a horror/ comedy interview styled SCP submission
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror, Comedy.

Page Layout (Optional):

Elevator Pitch:
A human skull that becomes sentient at a random point one day every week, with a friendly over dramatic demeanor, interested in nothing but bones. Knowledge of the entity was found by the foundation when reports of a skull, sitting atop piles of human/animal flesh was found. this scp has the ability of weak hypnosis over individuals to bring it desired bones, and an interest in the foundation itself, constantly going through classified files while just saying it wants to get to know the place.

  • list item

Central Narrative: After being put into foundation containment, scp-5212 awakes and then tries to strike up a conversation with researches working on it, it takes a liking to one researcher "Dr. Atlas" who conducts most of the interviews on the entity, and experiences scp-5212's ability to get whatever he wants from anyone he wants, using hypnosis (but while thinking they're just really good at convincing) after SCP-5212 gains access to highly classified information, Dr Atlas is terminated by higher up for failure to properly secure foundation secrets, and is replaced by "Dr. B" who scp-5212 eventually deals with.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: the entity has a mysterious personality and power, you don't know if its entertaining and fun demeanor is an act or not, or even if its from our own reality or just an explorer, the exact character of the skull is strange, and almost creepy in a way.

Additional Notes: scp-5212 is heavily story driven through its interviews and post interview report logs.

item.title: Deus Comedenti (Translation: God Eater)
item.description: A machine that can convert mass (specifically humans) into energy
item.content:encoded:
A machine that can convert mass (specifically humans) into energy. Utilized by a govt to power society, allowed mostly due to bureaucratic inertia

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror, Kafkaesque themes

Page Layout: It will be presented as an SCP Entry. The main narrative will be played out through the discovery logs and attached notes.

+ show block
– hide block

Elevator Pitch: There is a machine called "Deus Comedenti", latin for "God Eater". It was built to kill and harvest the energy of a God, but this fact is implied rather than told outright.

The machine can also be used to harvest energy from any sentient life (on par with humans, but not animals).It comes attached with a tower-like battery with a vast storage capacity (it's built to contain the sum of a God's power) the size of a 2 story building.

Even though each individual human provides a lot of power (in terms of electricity), it takes the equivalent of a genocide of tragic proportions to fill the battery even an 1/8th of the way. It was 1/3 full as found.

Central Narrative:
Basically this is set sometime in the near future where the transition from Oil to energy is more complete. Oil is thus almost obselete, and cars and the like which used to run on oil have been adapted to use electricity.

In this setting, the Foundation finds that India has been utilising the machine to meet the vast energy demands of the country. India's current biggest import is oil, so if oil is replaced with renewable energy, it makes sense that the country would try to develop an alternative way to produce energy, so as to reduce necessary imports where energy replaces oil as the biggest import. Large solar power plants are already being built in real life in India for much the same reason.

The energy obtained from the machine is 'laundered' through the solar power plants.

The scheme was introduced as a stop gap till a better energy source could be developed, but then inertia took hold. Since not many people were aware of it at any given time, and it served the purpose well, successive govts. decided it was easier to keep using it than to develop entirely new costly energy sources.

The human input is secretly obtained from prisons, and occasionally political prisoners are used.

India in this setting becomes a major proponent of "clean" energy, since it has a way to produce a lot of it, and becomes a leading energy exporter, creating another incentive for the govt not to discontinue the program.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
- Government approved systemic killing responsible for bringing basic amenity to society, with the general public being unaware of where the "clean energy" comes from
-Creation of energy via human sacrifice, facilitated by a machine created to kill a divine entity and harvest power from it, following E=MC^2.

Additional Notes: Let me know if the idea seems a bit too political or targeted. That's my main concern.
